cards.say: Six times six. Thirty six. A square number: six groups of six.
Six times seven. Forty two. Turn it round: seven times six equals forty two.
Six times eight. Forty eight. Turn it round: eight times six equals forty eight.
Six times nine. Fifty four. Turn it round: nine times six equals fifty four.
Six times ten. Sixty. Turn it round: ten times six equals sixty.
Eight times seven. Fifty six. Turn it round: seven times eight equals fifty six.
Eight times eight. Sixty four. A square number: eight groups of eight.
Eight times nine. Seventy two. Turn it round: nine times eight equals seventy two.
Eight times ten. Eighty. Turn it round: ten times eight equals eighty.
Nine times seven. Sixty three. Turn it round: seven times nine equals sixty three.
Nine times nine. Eighty one. A square number: nine groups of nine.
Nine times ten. Ninety. Turn it round: ten times nine equals ninety.
